title: Kokoro, tuned

tricks: Pause, breath and sigh use the native [pause:Ns] tag (a kokoro-fastapi v0.6.0 feature, exact spelling only, anything else is read aloud)
Sigh is a 0.5 s pause because a written Ahh... is spoken as a word
Laugh, um, cough and giggle have no native tag, so they are written out as spoken words (Haha!, Um, Ahem., Hehe!)

why: Kokoro at its best: af_heart, its best-graded voice, a touch faster, with the native pause tags for pause, breath and sigh and spoken stand-ins for the sounds it cannot make.
